title: Understand service prices and appointment timing
summary: Learn base and override prices, active time, processing and cleanup.

sections.title: How the price is chosen
sections.body: A staff-specific price takes priority over a location price, then the base price. **Starting from** changes the public wording; the chosen person and location still determine the applicable price. Blank overrides inherit the default. Zero is a real free price. Each service keeps its recorded currency.

sections.title: How timing is calculated
sections.body: **Client visit** includes active service time plus processing. **Calendar span** also includes cleanup or buffer. Active time and cleanup reserve staff. Processing may release staff only where the service’s actual configuration allows it; inspect the note in the editor. Required rooms or equipment can remain reserved according to their rules.

sections.title: Review or edit price and time
sections.body:
1. Open **Services** and select the service.
2. In **Overview → Price & duration**, review **Base price**, **Price display**, **Active service time**, **Cleanup / buffer** and **Processing time**.
3. Open **Team & locations** for branch or person exceptions. Leave an override blank when it should inherit the default.
4. Read **Client visit** and **Calendar span** at the top.
5. If upcoming appointments exist, review impact under **Booking & rules** and enter a reason for relevant changes.
6. Select **Save changes**.

sections.title: What happens to existing bookings
sections.body: Saved changes apply to new bookings and newly added checkout services. Existing appointments keep their recorded price, duration and performer. Editing a service does not resize the calendar or reprice completed sales. Tax-category references do not select a separate checkout tax rate.
